messages:
emma (partnerships): quick sync — can we lock down mechanics for marketplace onramp pricing? specifically: SKU gating, a 'reservation slope' (gradual commit requirement), and a renewal opt-in toggle for private offers. need to align HW partner & SI timelines. @vikas-sales @sasha-legal :eyes:
omar (pricing): i like 'reservation slope' wording. suggests we do 3 bands: trial (0-3mo), ramp (3-9mo with partial credit), committed (12mo floor). keeps flexibility for customers and predictable rev for partners.
sasha-legal: heads up — any auto-opt-in for renewal will need an explicit consent checkbox + clear MSA amendment. legal turn: ~10 business days for a standard addendum, longer if partner requires co-terms. avoid auto-enrollment without consent. :warning:
vikas-sales: from GTM side we want a clean upgrade path. propose discount tiers tied to calendar quarters and a 60d renewal notice window. also need a SKU mapping so reps can show ARR impact in SFDC. :+1:
jenna-ops: billing note — if we do partial credits for ramp band, we need to map meter_id -> credit_policy. otherwise ops workload spikes. can we standardize JSON for credit rules? e.g.:
```json
{
  "sku": "redwood.dedicated.gpu.a100.80gb",
  "tiers": [
    {"name":"trial","duration_days":90,"credit_pct":100},
    {"name":"ramp","duration_days":180,"credit_pct":50},
    {"name":"committed","duration_days":365,"credit_pct":0}
  ]
}
```
raj-eng: engineering can support the meter->credit join table. need clear fields: meter_id, partner_sku, effective_from, credit_pct, billing_behavior (invoice_credit vs. rebate). I'll drop a PR template if you want.
marta-marketing: for joint announcement we need a signed partner MSA + 2 weeks creative lead time. recommend we don't announce until the first reserved customer goes live (case study).
emma (partnerships): pragmatic timeline proposal: legal sign-off by Mar 31, ops mapping & engineering PR by Apr 7, partner co-marketing assets by Apr 14, pilot customer go-live Apr 21. is that realistic? @sasha-legal @jenna-ops
sasha-legal: Mar 31 is tight if partner has bespoke terms. if partner accepts our standard addendum it's fine. otherwise bump to Apr 7.
jenna-ops: engineering dependency looks fine for Apr 7 PR, but we need product QA for billing logic — add 1 week for QA -> Apr 14.
ovar (pricing): (typo) meant omar: minor comment — ensure discount math is idempotent when switching bands mid-cycle. otherwise customers see double credits.
emma (partnerships): action items:
- @sasha-legal: confirm partner MSA vs addendum by EOD Mon (owner: sasha-legal)
- @omar (pricing): final reservation slope numbers & discount calc doc by Wed
- @raj-eng + @jenna-ops: PR + billing mapping to internal schema by Apr 7
- @marta-marketing: draft joint launch outline and creative ask list by Apr 10
- @vikas-sales: list of pilot customers and sales pitch doc by Apr 7
please reply in-thread with any blockers. :rocket:
vikas-sales: noted. i'll share pilot customer list tomorrow. one ask — can we include a 30% 'early adoption' marketing credit for first 3 customers? free co-branded webinar + $10k credit. thoughts?
sasha-legal: marketing credit ok but needs in-contract limits (cap & usage boundaries). i'll draft wording.
omar (pricing): early adoption credit is fine if limited and not combinable with other discounts. add explicit exclusion in the discount rules.
emma (partnerships): perfect. i'll coordinate partner comms once legal confirms. tagging this for follow-up in next partnerships sync. :calendar:
jenna-ops: fyi i added a stub to the billing repo: refs/marketplace/sku-credit-policy. will ping when PR is ready.
raj-eng: created issue #4321 for meter join logic and test cases.
marta-marketing: saved notes for launch timeline, will sync creative with partner next Tue.
emma (partnerships): thanks all — closing thread for now. please flag if dates shift. :handshake:
